title: Bank request writes
description: Raising, correcting and cancelling one of the member's own booking requests. A request books nothing; the bank decides it in the Basetool. There is no undo: cancel a pending request instead.

raise.title: Raise a bank request
raise.description: A deposit may target any active account; a withdrawal or transfer needs an account the member may view. A deposit carries no justification; only a transfer names a destination; only a deposit may be split.

sourceAccountId.description: The request's account: the account a deposit is paid into, the account a withdrawal or transfer is paid from.

targetAccountId.description: The destination of a transfer; absent or null otherwise.

splitEnabled.description: Whether a deposit distributes splitPercent of its amount evenly across the squadron accounts on confirmation.

splitPercent.description: The whole percent a split deposit distributes; required with splitEnabled, absent otherwise.

correction.title: Correct a bank request
correction.description: Replaces amount, note, justification and destination of a pending, not yet approved own request; the type and the source account stay.

targetAccountId.description: The destination of a transfer; absent or null otherwise.

written.title: Raised or corrected bank request
written.description: Only the request's id, status, version and amount; read the request itself from the own requests.

id.description: Opaque identifier issued by the Basetool. Clients store and echo it, never parse it.
Opaque identifier issued by the Basetool. Clients store and echo it, never parse it.

accountId.description: An account id as the account reads answer it.

text.description: Plain text; the Basetool shows it as text, links are not clickable.

version.description: The request's version as last read; a stale one answers 409 VERSION_CONFLICT.
